text: The norelem brand in France is run by NORELEM SAS, a SASU (single-shareholder simplified joint-stock company) registered in Troyes (SIREN 432 505 741, capital 2 540 000 euros). The company register does not disclose its shareholder: beneficial-ownership data is restricted to authorised persons.
short: NORELEM SAS is a French SASU; its shareholder is not public.
